notes.title: StarRupture Single-Player Playtest available now
notes.content:
Featuring exciting single-player content, the StarRupture playtest will put you firmly into the treacherous world of Arcadia-7. Simply click the “[i]Request Access[/i]” button now on our Steam Page and enjoy it until July 31st.

While StarRupture is a co-op game at heart, where up to four players work together, we also want to ensure that the game is fun and engaging for those who play solo. 
This playtest will introduce you to the core elements of StarRupture, ranging from base building and exploration to survival and combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/39d1c56d37cd304499b73f115d1eea55e6338d55.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/6460036fe6da7948d75754d545b2dbcb612a41f8.png[/img]

[b]Welcome to StarRupture[/b], an intense first-person open-world survival game where you’ll build sprawling industrial bases, harvest valuable resources, and battle alien monsters. The planet is gorgeous, dangerous, and constantly evolving. Exploration, combat, and creativity are your keys to survival.

Meet Chris Bonnet - aka Prisoner 0212 - aka Scientist. He will be the character you play during the single-player playtest. You will have the opportunity to get to know him a little better during your time on Arcadia-7.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/7fc61da4a7cff71290591c7ced5e36b0e2007ab6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]🧪 Closed Playtest is available for a limited time only![/b][/h3]

The playtest kicks off J[b]uly 29 at 10:00 AM CEST / 1:00 AM PDT[/b] and ends [b]July 31 at 7:00 PM CEST / 10:00 AM PDT[/b]. To join, just head over to our Steam page and click “[i][b]Request Access[/b][/i]”. It’s that easy—and yes, it’s 100% free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/0d6a4f8cad9d9bbf6a3b5d3469a49d0d0d1a71bf.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]🎮 What’s in the Playtest?[/b][/h3]

The StarRupture Single-Player Playtest features over three hours of gameplay split between an early slice of the game featuring the game's core mechanics, a guided tutorial, and a free play option with map restrictions (the Playtest covers around 15% of the Early Access build map), but it’s a first taste of the fun that awaits in StarRupture. 

Some gameplay mechanics will be locked out for now (and left for you to fully explore when the game launches in Early Access this Autumn), such as wildlife, base attack and defense, corporate assignments and rewards over a certain level (6-7 depending on the corporation), the Forgotten Engine, some weapon unlocks with mods, and enemies. So don’t worry about the spoilers, the game will have plenty of fresh and new elements once it launches!

The Playtest supports English VO and interface localisation, and the full list of supported languages for StarRupture’s launch in Early Access is available on the game’s Steam Page.

There is no time limit on your session—play as much (or as little) as you want! However, [b]no co-op for now[/b]—we’re focusing on single-player balance and stability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8d30579e3715ea9492082d22d8de1eae107d7951.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]🧱 Platforms & Requirements[/b][/h3]

[*] [b]Platform:[/b] PC via Steam
[*] [b]Controller Support:[/b] Not available yet
[*] [b]Ultrawide Support:[/b] Nope—for now
[*] [b]Download Size: [/b]~13 GB (~45 GB after installation)
[*] [b]Hardware Requirements - recommended:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Windows 10 or later, 64-bit 
[*] Intel Core i5 11400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5600 
[*] 24 GB RAM 
[*] NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT 
[*] DirectX 12 
[*] SSD Disk[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]🗣️ Languages & Access[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Playtest is English-only for now (interface + audio). You might find a few cases of AI voiceover; they are currently included in the build as placeholders and will be replaced by proper actor recordings for the Early Access release.
[*] No NDA! Share your experience publicly—screenshots, streams, memes, go wild. Maybe show off your wakiest base? Or the most impressive kill?
[*] Players will be selected randomly by Steam and will receive email notifications when they’re eligible to play. No Steam key required—access is added to your account.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]💬 Feedback & Support[/b][/h3]

We want all kinds of feedback—from bug reports to general vibes and gameplay thoughts. Got a bug? Tell us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/starrupture]Discord[/url] or email support@creepyjar.com.

If you’d like to provide us with your feedback about the playtest, please fill out this short form:
https://forms.gle/WXi4ACxAakzCfozA6


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]❓Other Stuff You Should Know[/b][/h3]
[list][*] No criteria to sign up—just a PC and a Steam account
[*] If you’re not selected this round, you’re still in the pool for future tests
[*] There is no official age rating for the game yet, but we recommend 16+ (PEGI 16 / ESRB T guidelines)
[*] Want updates? Follow us on Steam and our socials
[*] Got questions? [url=https://discord.com/invite/starrupture]Join our Discord[/url]—our team and community are there to help
[*] More playtests? Stay tuned on our channels![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]🧠 The Big Goal[/b][/h3]

This test helps us with everything in the early game, including bug tracking, game balance, performance, feedback, and, most importantly, how the experience feels. You're helping shape StarRupture before its Early Access launch this Autumn. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/f8e6ead97f20ac7b59d0bbd2b9b2c31a817502ca.png[/img]

[b]PLAYTEST BUILD KNOWN ISSUES[/b]

Menu & Saves
[i][olist][*] Switching between tabs in the Options menu randomly causes some settings to become greyed out.
[*] The save file is not created in the slot selected by the player; it always saves to the first save slot on the left.[/olist][/i]
Gameplay
[i][olist][*] A crash may occur when attempting to place multiple Supported Platforms at once.
[*] A crash may occur when upgrading or deconstructing Rails.
[*] The game may temporarily freeze when placing multiple Supported Platforms for the first time in a session.
[*] Drones may stop delivering items to constructions. This can be resolved by deconstructing and rebuilding the affected rails and machines.
[*] When loading a save made during the Tutorial, the Tutorial widget does not appear until an objective is progressed.
[*] Dropped items stack up to a maximum of 100; any items beyond that limit disappear when dropped.
[*] If the Player obtains items with a full inventory, the excess items fall to the ground and may clip into each other.
[*] Deconstructing the entire base using the Deconstruction option in the Base Core spawns a container tower that may be unreachable by the Player.
[*] After reloading a session, all Quartz may disappear if the game was saved near a Quartz deposit. Quartz will reappear during the next Heat Wave.
[*] Unequipping the Building Tool while walking results in interrupting Player's movement.
[*] Hydration and Calories warning icons do not light up after loading a save.
[*] Machines set to OFF are turned back ON after reloading the save.
[*] The autosave function currently works only at the start and at the end of the tutorial.[/olist]
Visuals
[olist][*] The Map currently uses placeholder visuals.
[*] Enemies may occasionally appear slightly blurry or may flicker.
[*] Upon loading a save made during a Heat Wave, the critical temperature state and some visual effects may be missing.[/olist][/i]
Miscellaneous
[i][olist][*] Dialogues may overlap sporadically.[/olist][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8ef81461a9d35efde0799f882b581b59ac62f94c.png"][/img]

notes.title: Green Hell is now Verified on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

notes.title: Hotfix Patch: V 2.9.1 is live now!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

We are happy to announce that [b]the newest patch 2.9.1[/b] to Green Hell with Update #21 - Decorations [b]is now live[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png[/img][list][*] Tapir Trophy decoration added to the game
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/bcc715f2a8c1a31ae6049075ae16c326edb64f07.png[/img]
[list][*] The position of the decoration interface trigger should now be consistent for all players in co-op sessions
[*] Decorations on the workbench are displayed properly after the Client rejoins the session
[*] Light sources of torches in holders have now soother edges
[*] Enemies can now attack and destroy Armor Stands
[*] Decorations that are hung in the doorway and window walls have now the proper position
[*] Placing multiple Arrow Holders in one place should no longer be possible
[*] Tweaked position of decorations attached to short walls
[*] Using "Save & Quit" while sitting on the Chair no longer causes the interface to disappear
[*] The interface of decorations no longer disappears when the player leaves the co-op session while moving the decoration object
[*] Painting Bamboo Short Walls parts is now more accurate
[*] All decoration types on the Workbench now have a proper icon
[*] Enemies now properly find a path around an Arrow Holder
[*] Adjusted level of detail range for Feather Decorations
[*] Decorations that are being rearranged no longer collide with their initial position
[*] The player is now able to equip armors using the "insert" option on controllers
[/list]

Thank you so much for your support and feedback - we could not find and fix these bugs without you!
Remember, you can report any possible issues with the game by sending us a message at support@creepyjar.com


[i]Creepy Jar Team[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/815370/Green_Hell/


[u]Join Green Hell community on Discord:[/u]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/greenhell][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/c34541bf6da6b77647a98c63b8cea9f095198232.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Green Hell: Anniversary Edition - Out Now on Steam
notes.content:
Take your survival skills beyond the game with this special Anniversary Edition of Green Hell for anyone seeking the ultimate survival experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/043aeba8933d7654fd0990afd0434caadfed6ece.jpg[/img]

[h2]Green Hell: Anniversary Edition contains:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Green Hell Game[/b] - the base game with 21 free content updates.
[*] [b]The Art of Green Hell[/b] - a digital artbook showing the art of Green Hell, which includes official never-before-seen concepts, in-game graphics, and much more!
[*] [b]Green Hell Official Soundtrack[/b] - a 3-part official Green Hell OST, composed by Adam Skorupa, Krzysztof Wierzynkiewicz and Michał Cielecki. Take the jungle with you wherever you go.
[*] [b]Exclusive Digital Posters[/b] - a set of high-quality PDFs with Green Hell posters, which you can print on your own and decorate your gaming den.
[*] [b]Desktop Wallpapers[/b] -  a set of 4K & Full HD Green Hell-themed wallpapers to add some Amazonian flair to your PC desktop.
[*] [b]Avatar Images[/b] - a set of Avatar artworks with Green Hell characters and motives to decorate your user profile on Steam or in other community groups.
[*] [b]Digital Emojis[/b] - a set of fan-favorite Capybara emojis to use on your community servers, like Discord.
[/list]

[i]After obtaining Green Hell: Anniversary Edition, you will find the Anniversary Edition’s Artbook, Soundtrack, and Digital Goodies in the game's installation folder.[/i]

notes.title: Free Update #21 - Decorations | Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

The 21st, Free Update for Green Hell is now available!

The entire team had so much fun while creating this update. We were constantly giving each other new ideas about what could also be added to it, that in its final form, there’s so much new stuff to play with! See them in the trailer below:
[previewyoutube=ERz2eKEZlJM;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png[/img]

[h2]New mechanic: [b]Painting [/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/3cf693fcba26b86bf1e8afe27c1e0a43fd180d9d.gif[/img]

Yes! Now you can paint all kinds of constructions & the newly added decorations. 

After you equip yourself with Paints made from different bugs and other colorful elements, you can create your Paintbrush out of some Fiber, Rope, and a Stick. That is how you can paint your base and color your furniture! Just pick a tint from our Amazonian color collection: white, blue, red, green, or yellow, and make the jungle even more vibrant! 

This mechanic will work with the newly added decorations and the items that you’ve already constructed as well! So be creative, and let your imagination go wild!

[h2]New construction: [b]Workbench[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/ed9025f71f8580311d0e5a153d991d58c4fdc0ac.gif[/img]

The Workbench definitely will be your new best friend with this update. It will enable crafting all different kinds of decorations for your base. 

[h2]New constructions: [b]Decorations[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/cd02120adf9c313808cd89e8ffce00962fe152aa.jpg[/img]
So… much… new… stuff… to… decorate… your… base!!!

With the use of the Workbench, you will be able to craft yourself some serious furniture items which will make your home-sweet-home even more cozy! You can craft a Table, a Chair, a Bench, a Night Stand and various Paintings to set a proper mood, or even mount some Animal Trophies to show off your hunting skills to others! 

As something extra, we’ve also prepared some Rope, Leaf, and Bone Decorations for those who like pretty (or creepy!) stuff.

[h2]New constructions: [b]Armor Stand & Arrow Holder[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/698d88c45a5306f26bdcedddc80c44f36efe10ae.jpg[/img]
You’ve asked for it, and there we have it! 

Thanks to these new Stands you will be able to store your Arrows securely and showcase your neatly crafted Armors on a display they deserve. 

[h2]New constructions: [b]Torch Stand & Torch Holder[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/dbc0b1256788839b089a050837e26b978c7768c8.gif[/img]

Now these are constructions, we’ve been cooking for a long time. They’ve been sitting in our backlog for years now, but now we’ve got the right tools to complete them and make them shine! 

You can place the Torch Holders inside your base to set a proper mood at night, and use the Torch Stands at strategic points on the map to easily direct you in the wilderness. Just remember - the torches won’t be burning forever and you will need to maintain them if you don’t want to be suddenly surrounded by the darkness of the night again.

[h2]New mechanic: [b]Rearranging[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/e0dbff8c9c28b1fb18628a619e7728ee91e3e0b1.gif[/img]

Thanks to this new mechanic, you can rearrange the decorations you’ve created and move them to another place. 

Don’t like the table standing in the corner? No problem, you can just move it to the nearby window. The painting is not looking great on that wall, huh? Just move it aside, or place it along the collection of your other paintings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/82d485db0b6cad68816d586c157a53972971fe91.jpg[/img]


[h1]CELEBRATE WITH CAPYBARA PLUSHIE[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/cabf4c94d1bfbe23ac4d7ddbe9ee71d83fc5b527.jpg[/img]
Additionally, as part of our Green Hell Anniversary celebration, we’ve teamed up with Makeship to bring you for the very first time an official Green Hell merch!

This lovely Capybara looks cute, but - in fact - is ready for some serious survival action with its cute Green Hell gear. Equipped with Stone Axe and Machete, Capybara can go out and seek adventures both in the vast Amazonian Rainforest or even in the nooks and crannies of your gaming rooms… Cappy in her backpack also carries a banana - as nutrition is really important when you’re exploring the wilderness!

https://www.makeship.com/products/green-hell-capybara-plushie


Be sure to secure your Cappy Plushie, as the campaign is time-limited!



[h1][b]AN IMPORTANT MESSAGE FROM CREEPY JAR[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/4f81dc0993aa9f06e9045ef674c8037530267ca3.jpg[/img]
Our adventure with Green Hell comes to an end with this free content update. Since the release of the game in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/815370/view/1585752541655242400]the 1.0 version back in 2019[/url], we’ve been updating it regularly with free content updates - including the huge 3-part story mode [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/815370/view/3095668665765765175]“Spirits of Amazonia”[/url], as well as gameplay changing updates like the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/815370/view/3654142288749174512]“Building Update”[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/815370/view/3692442542224759258]“Storage & Transportation”[/url], or completely new additional gameplay enriching mechanics as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/815370/view/3877098283555930559]"Fortifications"[/url] & [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/815370/view/3946909242510401320]"Flamekeeper"[/url]. And now - with teary eyes - [b]we’ve decided to publish this one more and final update to the game and make the Green Hell experience complete[/b].

The game won’t be getting any more new content updates on PC, but it will still be supported by our team.

We’re super grateful for your support throughout the years, for the feedback you’ve been providing us with, for the stories you’ve told us about your experience, and for the adventures you’ve lived in the game. This fueled us to provide you with even more opportunities to craft new stories and have even more adventures in Green Hell. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/60360500a7aaa64ed682e9e00a62500b584f7ca3.jpg[/img]
Now it’s time for us to prepare another adventure for you - the whole team is now working hard on our next big title. We are devoted to make it a great title fused with the experience gained and lessons learned while creating Green Hell, and the things you’ve told us you loved about our game. So we hope we will see you soon in our own new sci-fi universe - in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/]StarRupture[/url].

Yours truly,
[i]Creepy Jar Team[/i]

And now - with teary eyes - [b]we’ve decided to publish this one more and final update to the game and make the Green Hell experience complete[/b].
The game won’t be getting any more new content updates on PC, but it will still be supported by our team.

We’re super grateful for your support throughout the years, for the feedback you’ve been providing us with, for the stories you’ve told us about your experience, and for the adventures you’ve lived in the game.
This fueled us to provide you with even more opportunities to craft new stories and have even more adventures in Green Hell.
Now it’s time for us to prepare another adventure for you - the whole team is now working hard on our next big title.
We are devoted to make it a great title fused with the experience gained and lessons learned while creating Green Hell, and the things you’ve told us you loved about our game.
So we hope we will see you soon in our own new sci-fi universe - in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/]StarRupture[/url].

notes.title: Free Update #20 - Anteater | Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

Today is the day! We are proud to announce that the Free Update #20 for Green Hell - "Anteater" is available now! 

The name of our latest free update hides many more new & fresh features than the name might suggest. Alongside having added new animals to your Animal Pen, we’ve prepared a bunch of cool mechanics and enhancements to the rest of the game. See the Anteater in action in the newest trailer, and if you’d like to dive into the update’s details - see the notes below.

[previewyoutube=XZ7FggBdlmU;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png[/img]

[h2]New animal: [b]Giant Anteater[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/f6c34cab534f56947e13c41fd4bb7264cbbebcb2.gif[/img]
The most exciting part of this update is the Giant Anteater. Some call him amusing, some think he’s cute, but he can be very aggressive - so you need to watch out! 
Naturally, you will be able to find this beast near anthills. He’s usually shy and will try to avoid you, but when threatened - he will not hesitate to use his claws to protect himself and might deal you great damage.


[h2]New mechanic: [b]Spawning anthills[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/59b912c6adcb335d70099d98ff1c9f70917df2dd.jpg[/img]
You may remember anthills from Green Hell before, stepping inside them and getting those pesky ants crawling all over you, or collecting the ants to mend your laceration wounds. But now, anthills may also serve as your guidepost to the place anteaters hang out most.

Until now, the only thing you could have done is either avoid or harvest an anthill. But now you can also destroy them! Destroying an anthill won’t provide you with more ants, but if you find an anthill standing in your way to build something, or if it blocks your path and you keep bumping into it, you will be able to remove it. Don’t worry, though; ants will always find a new spot to build a new house for their colony, so from now on a new anthill will soon appear in a nearby area. With some more animals looking for them, including the infamous anteater and… an armadillo?!


[h2]New mechanic: [b]New animals in your animal pen[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/ab5ca4912f408b0993e0004e46ccd90da78445ce.jpg[/img]
The Animal Husbandry update introduced the ability to breed some of the animal species from the jungle. Now, we are adding even more animals to your menagerie, as you will be able to breed Armadillos, Three-banded Armadillos, and - of course - Giant Anteaters!


[h2]New construction: [b]Composter[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/91bd6769a085586b9dfec90af0a10716ef341911.png[/img]
Thanks to this simple construction you will be able to dispose of such things as rotten meat, spoiled food, leaves, animal drops, and everything organic in general - and not necessarily only expired things! As a product of such action, you will receive compost (see more details about this new item in the section below), and insects with which you will be able to feed your pack of Armadillos and Anteaters.


[h2]New item: [b]Compost[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/90a4a0931b03dc39b6fcaa90a9a6bc5a73de8654.gif[/img]
Show your plants some love with the new, organic, homemade superfood - Compost!
Compost is the most important and most fertilizing product of the Composter. With this nutritious and rich substance, you can elevate your planting skills to a higher level! 


[h2]New construction: [b]Feeding Trough - Insects[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/21d2669ab5b017b730e96cbb8d852295172072b9.png[/img]
As you now have some new pals to take care of in your animal pen, you will need a way to feed them. By using this new construction, you will be able to feed anteaters and armadillos with insects. [i]Bon appétit![/i]


[h2]New mechanic: [b]Parrot keeping[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/998b018fa21f4abedf35ea583f497a03a5ed32a8.gif[/img]
Now you can lure parrots into your base - or any other place where you build a Parrot Nest - where parrots can fly into and become accustomed to your presence.


[h2]New construction: [b]Parrot Nest[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/04cd231222eccc459ac9c4d662e9fa9c269e8627.png[/img]
When you manage to get parrots safe and comfy in your Parrot Nest, you will be rewarded with feathers and eggs left by the birds. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/9f3e1f5311e2b75c3d3d52f56f53517d4e247681.png[/img]
And that’s all in this #20 free content update! As usual, thank you so much for supporting the game. We welcome all your thoughts and feedback on our discord server.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/1916f8b037064d73130a67e42694c1d352bdb51d.gif[/img]
Last but not least, keep your eyes peeled for our next update for Green Hell! Be sure it will make your Amazonian home super cozy!

Happy anteating!
Creepy Jar Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/52956470226aefe62b17426e6ba0a3d5fdbeadf3.png[/img]

PS. 
[i]Aside from supporting Green Hell with new free updates, we're hard at work on our next title, StarRupture. Being built in Unreal Engine 5, StarRupture is an ambitious cross between base building, exploration, combat, and resource management on an alien planet torn by a catastrophic cycle of destruction. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1631270/view/4111296332071442957]See what we're up to with StarRupture over here, where we’ve lately published our devlog about building your base.[/url][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/815370/Green_Hell/


[u]Join Green Hell community on Discord:[/u]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/greenhell][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/c34541bf6da6b77647a98c63b8cea9f095198232.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Hotfix Patch: V 2.7.1 is live now!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

We are happy to announce that the newest patch 2.7.1 to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/815370/view/3946909242510401320?l=english]Green Hell with Update #19 - Flamekeeper[/url] is now live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/bcc715f2a8c1a31ae6049075ae16c326edb64f07.png[/img]
Crashes:
[list]
[*] The game no longer crashes after destroying constructions that are connected directly to the Elevator
[*] The game no longer crashes while taking Logs from the Log Stand
[*] The game no longer crashes after exiting a session while the Eternal Flame is being extinguished
[*] Opening the Notebook while carrying a lit Torch no longer causes a game crash for other players in the session
[*] Fixed some additional crashes that occur randomly on saves provided by the community
[/list]

Flamekeeper:
[list]
[*] Triggers to interact with Eternal Flame should no longer be hard to find if dead Tribesmen are nearby
[*] The player should not be able to build constructions that block access to the Eternal Flame rewards
[*] Tribesmen now despawn faster after the Eternal Flame is extinguished
[*] FX of the ignited Eternal Flame no longer causes graphical distortion
[*] UI prompts showing the Ritual of Fire events now display properly for all players in the co-op session
[*] The status of the Eternal Flame is the same for all players after reloading a co-op session
[*] Bow Trap no longer kills Thugs with one hit
[*] Tribesmen AI when trying to get to the player should now focus more on destroying constructions
[*] Tribesmen summoned by the Eternal Flame are now more likely to focus on the Lookout Platforms
[*] Metal Arrowheads rewarded in the Ritual of Flame are now easier to pick up
[*] Smoke that appears when Tribesmen try to extinguish Eternal Flame now disappears and appears smoothly
[*] Voices of Tribesmen spawning for Ritual of Flame are now louder
[*] Wasp nest attack audio effects are now improved
[*] The player is no longer able to craft Ritual of Flame Herbs in the Story Mode
[/list]

Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Taking damage while switching or throwing a weapon no longer causes HUD to get blocked
[*] Animations of the bow no longer freeze when the player gets damaged during shooting
[*] The vertical camera angle range is increased - the player can pick up items that are close to Jake's feet
[*] Receiving damage while switching weapons no longer causes animation mismatch
[*] The player can no longer use Body Inspection while in the Elevator
[/list]

The Spirits of Amazonia:
[list]
[*] Jake's hands no longer blur when entering the water in Spirits of Amazonia underwater arena
[*] The surface of the water in Spirits of Amazonia underwater arena no longer displays a graphical distortion
[*] Thug Tribesmen should now properly spawn in Spirits of Amazonia camps
[/list]

Story:
[list]
[*] Tribesmen spawned by low sanity no longer freeze when the player is on the upper levels of a construction
[*] Skybox no longer displays graphical distortion during the final Dream sequence in the Story Mode
[/list]

Co-op:
[list]
[*] Meat on the Dryers and Fireside Walls no longer duplicate in co-op sessions
[*] Icons on the Grill Rack now display properly for all players in the co-op session
[*] Co-op players are no longer able to insert items into the Fence or Palisade ghost before it is properly set
[/list]

Constructions:
[list]
[*] Triangular Frame now behaves properly after the constructions underneath it are destroyed
[*] Weapons no longer change color during interaction with construction ghosts
[*] The gap between the first snap point to other fences and palisades is reduced
[*] Grass and tiny plants no longer flicker when a construction is being completed
[*] Triangular Frames can now be properly placed on upper levels of a construction
[/list]

UI/Graphics/Accessibility:
[list]
[*] Icons on the items' HUD now display properly in the Expand Menu
[*] Using the Expand Menu on animals from the Animal Pen no longer causes all animals to freeze
[*] Texts describing the Venom Wound in the Notebook no longer overlap
[*] Change Direction' has now a proper Icon when using a Controller
[*] Notebook tabs now scroll in a proper order when using a Controller
[/list]

Thank you so much for your support and feedback - we could not find and fix these bugs without you!
Remember, you can report any possible issues with the game by sending us a message at support@creepyjar.com


[i]Creepy Jar Team[/i]

notes.title: Update #19 - Flamekeeper | Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/e2c0f472e98130fe0545703fa300a8cdbe0f2e1c.jpg[/img]
Hello Adventurers,

We’re excited to announce “[b]Flamekeeper[/b]” - our 19th free content update, now available for Green Hell on PC!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/815370/view/3877098283555930559]Our previous update - “Fortifications”[/url], was just a prelude to what we’ve been working on - the long-awaited “combat update”. By providing you the possibility to create fences, palisades, and gates, we wanted to create ways for strategically fortifying your base and yourself from various enemies and wild animal attacks. With “Flamekeeper”, you should level up your skill and make new defenses to keep the flame alive!

[previewyoutube=b4LKclN4_lw;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png[/img]

[h2]New construction: [b]Eternal Flame[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/d17093e2f9a8f4b4e1ed21510c6957f05283b3a0.jpg[/img]
The main hero of our update - the Eternal Flame Totem! With this new construction that you can create in Waraha Villages, you will be able to launch the Ritual of Flame.

[h2]New gameplay mechanics: [b]Ritual of Flame[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/dbad5fbde2e7ce1def0463f73c404ae0da832443.gif[/img]
Improve your Totem by gathering the necessary materials and launching the Ritual of Flame. Survive the enemy horde and its attack, stop them from extinguishing the Eternal Flame, and receive an award. Think fast or create your strategy - get the help of your friends, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/815370/view/3877098283555930559]create advanced fortifications, which we added in the previous update[/url].

[h2]New enemy attack type: [b]Wasp Nest[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/01052724eaf91ad14551845e93773d526ef7dc14.gif[/img]
In the previous update, we’ve added improvements to the enemy's AI. Now we’re boosting their abilities even further with their new skill. When they aren’t able to reach you - they will unleash their new attack! By throwing the wasp nest, they will be able to lure you out of your “stronghold”. Hiding on a tree or an upper floor or your base won’t be so easy now, huh?

[h2]New weapon: [b]War Club[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/170d86fc5d73c17a0261f9942d3ec4dfc6fd441b.jpg[/img]
Survive all 50 stages of the Flamekeeper Challenge and receive a unique award: “War Club” -[b] the most powerful weapon in the game so far[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/dc4958de89e03b2bad96665a4d057a5f2b27c60f.jpg[/img]
We know our community is super skilled and creative, so we can’t wait to read your stories and see your photos & videos on how you’re fighting against the enemy's attack waves to keep the totem flame safe. Share your records on social media with #GreenHell, or tell us on our Discord to which wave you’ve managed to level up your Flamekeeper. 

Follow Green Hell on Steam to be the first to know about the upcoming new content, and join our Discord to chat with us and our awesome community, where you can share screenshots of your newly fortified bases & Eternal Flames. 

[u]Keep the flame alive![/u]
[i]Creepy Jar Team[/i]

notes.title: Say “Hello” to StarRupture & watch our first devlog!
notes.content:
[b]We’re shedding the mythological shackles of the game’s previous title and proudly announcing a new name perfectly suited for our ambitious sci-fi setting![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/fcf974a9207d1b73aeb4624e74ecc7d28f88eaa5.jpg[/img]
Hello Players!

Earlier this year, as part of the summer edition of the PC Gaming Show, we revealed our next game - a unique mix of base building, exploration, resource management, and combat on an alien planet torn by a catastrophic cycle of destruction caused by its life-giving star. 

Now - we’re excited to reveal the game’s new title—one that we feel is much more representative of the unique world we’re creating—say hi to “[i]StarRupture[/i]”.

[previewyoutube=8AeQeigwU8Y;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to this news, we’re launching our devlog series about the game. In the first part, we want to show you a deeper look into the name change and everything that the team’s been working on since the game’s reveal. Check it out below:

[previewyoutube=RpzbZqdPth8;full][/previewyoutube]
As we work towards StarRupture’s Early Access PC launch, we will release further devlogs in the coming months for exclusive behind-the-scenes looks at the development process.

Everything from production milestones to sneak peeks at some of the game’s many mechanics, enemies, and mysteries are all on the table. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/9315edf005a0768aad17f6a0ce80a55d37e4c028.png[/img]

We’re excited to continue sharing with you more updates on StarRupture, as much as we were focused on doing so with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/815370/Green_Hell/]Green Hell[/url]. Be assured that we’re still supporting Green Hell with new & free content updates - we recently released Update #18 Fortifications, which is the prelude to our next, awesome update - but more details about it will be posted soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/

Wishlist and follow our game here on Steam - it will help us a lot! - and our brand-new social media channels, to be the first to know about our future news for the game. 

Stay secure within your fortifications!
[i]Creepy Jar Team[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #18 - Fortifications | Available now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/01c9702ae3009d49945e5bfa2b8e13bfc96757a3.jpg[/img]
[h2]Hello Adventurers,[/h2]

We’re happy to announce our [b]brand-new 18th content update[/b] to Green Hell titled “[b]Fortifications[/b]”, which is [b]AVAILABLE NOW[/b] to all Green Hell players on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/0dc6c8d2e06ba131877470fc915a5721d4567a97.jpg[/img]

If you remember our latest roadmap, the next big update will be based on the fight against the enemy tribes. During its development, we discovered it was hard to imagine how to defend a base without proper defensive structures. 
That is why with this newest update [b]we’re bringing new constructions that will help you in working on new defense strategies[/b]. Are you annoyed that anyone can enter and even try to destroy your cherished base? Wait no more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/59842850d14bc66e6029ae4a49f04a50caf733be.png[/img]

[h2][b]Fences[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/fb91c1e4765deca92d539b754eac4e7c6cbbd3a7.jpg[/img]
The first of the new upgrades we’re bringing live is the ability to build simple fences made from wood or bamboo. They are [b]not the most durable of the bunch[/b] but they are a [b]good choice if you’re short of supplies[/b]. 

[h2][b]Palisades[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/7982c0d6710e3a223f1ea79c8b8fcd4136c52f61.jpg[/img]
If you prefer to build something even more [b]solid and sturdy [/b]- we got you covered! With wooden and bamboo palisades you can wall yourself away from most of the dangers that await you in the wilderness.

[h2][b]Gates[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/fe08d6d0eced40159c5f04b1a9771d3b7cbdafe3.gif[/img]
No base feels complete without a proper gate! Select from wooden and bamboo gates - remember to close them, you don’t want to get caught in a draught! 

[h2][b]Lookout platforms[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/45dc95bb94bc555aef2bb36c35ad52acee4c9474.gif[/img]
Do you like to lurk on your uninvited guests? You can always wait on them with a warm soup or a drawn bow on [b]the new ramp construction[/b] - you know, it’s always better to have a higher ground!

[h2][b]Enemies AI improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/68bf38af5c58193ce89ab1b9a56dccc8b378ae4b.jpg[/img]
If you like to play hide and seek with enemies - it won’t be so easy now, as [b]tribesmen will be able to enter low structures built by the player[/b]. So watch out - they may get to you while you are on platforms floating on water or the ones built on the ground. We are very curious about what you think about this change, [url=https://discord.com/invite/greenhell]let us know on our Discord channel[/url].

[h2][b]More to come![/b][/h2]
This is[b] just a prelude [/b]to what we’re cooking up for Green Hell… In addition to all the new content added to Green Hell with Update #18, we’ve implemented [b]general optimization fixes that will broaden our horizons[/b] for further development of the game. [b]Stay tuned for more info regarding future updates😉[/b]

Follow Green Hell on Steam to be the first to know about the upcoming new content and join our Discord to chat with us and our awesome community, where you can share screenshots of your newly fortified bases.

[u]Stay cozy in your new fortresses![/u]

[i]Creepy Jar Team[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/815370/Green_Hell/

[url=https://discord.com/invite/greenhell][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/c34541bf6da6b77647a98c63b8cea9f095198232.png[/img][/url]

notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

The newest hotfix to Storage and Transportation is live! We hope you enjoy the newest update!

Here is the full list of patch notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/bcc715f2a8c1a31ae6049075ae16c326edb64f07.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Game no longer crashes when the Host closes a co-op session while the Client is using the Sled
[*] Game no longer crashes when attempting to deliver Water to a Fisherman in the Spirits of Amazonia Mode
[*] Constructions no longer remain in the air after the flooring underneath has been destroyed 
[*] Footbridges can now be build more easily between Doorways
[*] The requirement for building a Small Fire under Ayahuasca cauldrons is now properly displayed and the cauldrons are usable for all Players in co-op sessions
[*] The boat in the Spirits of Amazonia storyline can be fully repaired - even after a session reload
[*] Crouching while using the Sled is now disabled
[*] Player can no longer use the Sled while holding a Heavy Object
[*] Player is no longer able to interact with the Airport Radio while using the Sled
[*] Items can no longer duplicate if placed inside a Construction Ghost which is close to the Sled
[*] Finishing building the Sled no longer cuts the grass underneath it
[*] The rendering distance of the Elevator has been adjusted
[*] Player is now able to move the entire stack of items onto a Shelf
[*] Fire starting items no longer reset their durability when put on Shelves
[*] Bidons and Bottles no longer lose their contents upon reloading a game save
[*] Interaction range for weapons put on Bamboo Weapon Rack has been adjusted
[*] Weapon position on Bamboo Weapon Rack has been adjusted
[*] Weapon Rack can now be properly destroyed by all Players in a co-op session
[*] Campfires can now be properly placed under the Smokers and Campfire Racks that are located on higher floors of the base
[*] River Mud which has been dropped during swimming now properly despawns
[*] Fast Pick Up option in game is now properly capitalized in all languages
[/list]
As always, thank you for your constant support and feedback - we would not be able to do it without you.

Sled on!

Creepy Jar Team

notes.title: Storage & Transportation Update is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Adventurers![/h1]
[b]The Storage & Transportation Update[/b] is officially live and available for free for all Steam players! 

[previewyoutube=ooscPx_31EQ;full][Trailer]
[/previewyoutube]

As many of Green Hell’s most experienced players know, efficiency is of the utmost importance if you want to survive in the Amazon jungle. To stay efficient, your base needs perfect space management which improves the process of gathering the necessary food supplies or materials. In addition, every trip across the rainforest puts you in untold danger, so why make more trips than is needed? 

Storage and Transportation patch will help you with that, so just check out what's new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png[/img]

[h2]Sled[/h2]
A great tool for transporting heavy objects. What’s more, you can put up to two different types of Heavy Objects in one Sled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/b04b9e475fdcdbc2b2578381ff586107cde82f53.gif[/img]

[i]We know how much players like to build vast and complex bases. Resources near the base may quickly run out and you have to go deeper and deeper into the jungle for materials. We decided to speed up material transport by adding sleds, to help our players spend more time building and less time running around for materials. [/i]

[h2]Elevator[/h2] 
Treehouse or multi-story villa, the elevator is the new easier way of transporting heavy resources up and down. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/f218293c672127b9e14a9d2dad7b064c4d9ec98d.gif[/img]

[i]In the last building update, we added new construction to build a treehouse. We noticed that transporting a large amount of materials to the upper floors using a ladder is inconvenient, so we decided to add a new construction - an elevator.[/i]

[h2]Shelf and Hanging Shelf[/h2]
A new type of universal storage, in which you can unpack most of the items from your Backpack - excluding weapons and building materials such as sticks (they still need to be put on dedicated stands). Thanks to the new shelves, you can see the status of your stock at a glance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/8f7d90aafe2c6f1e811f70868c765130f3f4369b.png[/img]

[i]We felt that there should be a universal storage for smaller items in Green Hell, where you can see what items it contains without interaction and from a distance. This type of shelf is also aesthetic and looks nice in the base.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/c0afb173cc6c0e47b302f47784c5078f459e1ba1.png[/img]

[h2]Quick Pick Up[/h2]
With the option to turn off animation delay for picking up items you no longer have to wait for animation to complete to pick another item. The faster you click, the faster you pick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/5be64d6b22bdc0e295cf1dd9268f21253abc1049.gif[/img]

[i]After adding the elevator and sled, we noticed that the delay in the pick-up animation was disrupting the dynamics of the resource harvesting process. That's why we decided to remove this delay. However, during our beta testing, we received feedback that this change affects immersion for some players, so we decided to add the option to disable this improvement in the game options.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/400b72c742444b8f2a3b7e1e06368a2c9bafa2e4.png[/img]

[h2]Baskets[/h2]
A reworked version of the Small and Big Stone Stands are renamed to Baskets and now can hold various types of objects, such as stones, bones, planks, green coconuts, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/f6f91791dac59990efa0e04cbf467afc432c5ca8.jpg[/img]
[i]As we aim for immersion we thought that the stone basket looks like it can hold similar items, so instead of making new types, we decided to make our stone stands more versatile. Now you can choose what to use it for.[/i]

[h2]New Bamboo versions of Stands[/h2]
Every storage construction now has its bamboo version. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/62d5494f117ba9661b1dee968255fe6c603f1b53.png[/img]

[i]Since The Building Update, we have been trying to give players the opportunity to build their base using any materials. We noticed some wooden structures did not have their bamboo counterparts at all. So, while working on Storage and Transportation Update we wanted to improve the storage system as well by adding a missing bamboo stands.[/i]


[h2]One universal Leaf Stand [/h2]
Leaf Stand now has two slots. You can choose what materials you want to stack in each slot: Banana or Palm leaves. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/6ebdf0d7e2b159836e3f05f629f0f0cd58e74852.png[/img]

[h2]Universal  Wood Stands[/h2]
Stands for logs and sticks made of bamboo or wood can store both wood and bamboo materials in each, e.g. wooden materials can be stored in bamboo racks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/0aff429d91b2008e1d522c076c69e8d550836a06.png[/img]

[i]So far, the rack system has been very restrictive. For example, to store a Bamboo Log, the player had to build a rack using the same material. It wasn't exactly the optimal solution. So we decided to give players a little more freedom and the ability to change the type of stored material when the structure is already built.[/i]

[h2]Increased capacity of Stands [/h2]
All stands have now increased capacity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/d1668840c8053157d157faf18e8651ea5b10ef31.png[/img]
[i]Since The Building Update, we've been trying to encourage players to build bigger and bigger bases. After playtests, it turned out that the current capacity of material storage structures is simply too small and players have to devote more and more space for these structures.[/i]

[h2]Improved item storing & pick-up mechanic[/h2]
Now you can place and take out an item in storage with a single button, and take it out with another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/bcc715f2a8c1a31ae6049075ae16c326edb64f07.png[/img]

[list]
[*]	Game no longer crashes after trying to stack Armadillo Meat together with other meats
[*]	System of construction snapping was reworked. It is now more convinient to attach Ghosts to already built Constructions
[*]	Snapping the Ladder to Triangular Frames is adjusted
[*]	Building and using Climbing Places is now more convinient
[*]	Improved render distance of constructions added in Building Update
[*]	Tree Platforms' Ghosts now collide with each other, preventing from building new inside the existing one
[*]	Player can no longer snap multiple Construction Ghosts to one spot
[*]	Frog Stretcher progress icon now updates properly for all Players in co-op session
[*]	Already placed construction Ghost doesn't disappear when player rapidly presses Q just after placing it
[*]	Mud Fireside Wall can be now properly built on Tringular Frames with roof on top
[*]	Triangular Banana Leaf Roof now properly casts shadow
[*]	Size of Notebook Constructions drawings is adjusted
[*]	Doors now have proper state after reloading the save
[*]	Disabling Head Bob no longer causes input issues when fighting with the Tribes
[*]	Players' input should no longer be blocked when petting an animal in crowded environment
[*]	Opening Notebook / Map during Blowgun reload animation no longer causes an input lock
[*]	Pressing a right stick on a Controller no longer causes crafting animation to loop
[*]	Player longer gets stuck when opening Map / Notebook while using the Pottery Table
[*]	Sample Analyzer in Story can be now properly used by any Player in co-op session after the reload
[*]	Ghost for putting down Kid in Spirits of Amazonia villages is now properly displayed for all players in co-op session
[*]	Player is no longer able to craft Spirits of Amazonia arena weapons during the Tutorial
[*]	Kid from the Spirits of Amazonia first village no longer falls down the bridge after being spawned
[*]	It should no longer be possible to bypass the Snake Pass in Spirits of Amazonia
[*]	Picking up the Kid from the deep water now works properly
[*]	Planting Boxes put on the Triantular Frames' roofs now get proper hydration from the rain
[*]	Changing name of a fruit directly on a plant now works properly
[*]	Climbing on Floating Frames while carrying multiple Heavy Objects now works properly
[*]	Player can now put only one Heavy Object of each type on the Crafting Table
[*]	Heavy objects are no longer stuck to Player's hands while drowning
[*]	Stingray Sting can be now used to remove underskin worm
[*]	Unlocking Animal Pen by interacting with Snare Trap now gives a proper notification
[*]	Player can no longer tranqulize baby animals
[*]	Gender of the animal no longer changes randomly when reloading a session
[*]	After session reload, animals no longer disappear if they were called
[*]	Name of the tied animal no longer resets to default after session reload
[*]	Unlit fire no longer displays overlapping text
[*]	Unlit Torch no longer displays overlapping text when trying to ignite it from Campfire
[*]	All small items can now be properly picked up from the slots at the Campfire
[*]	"Items that are put on the campfire by using 'insert' button should be fully visible"
[*]	Player can no longer place soups or infusions in Clay Bottle
[*]	Big Stone no longer disapperas from the Crafting Table after running while using Controller
[*]	Bowls thrown into deep water can now be properly picked up
[*]	Trunks of cut down large palms now work properly after a session reload
[*]	Players are now able to wash themselves in any body of water while standing under cover
[*]	Fishes cought by spear fishing now always land in Inventory of Player who cought it in co-op session
[*]	Two hand axes now take one hit to destroy Green Coconut
[*]	Resetting Key Bindings to default now works properly
[*]	Player can now save changes on the frame rate error pop-up
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/18cf59525a9f8a6b0ae5430045a5f281830acf58.jpg[/img]

We hope that you liked all the updates and they will definitely improve the comfort of “living” in the Amazon jungle. All these new improvements will allow you to fully devote yourself to the adventure, as well as build your dream house and spend more time petting capybaras.

Creepy Jar Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/815370/Green_Hell/


[u]Join Green Hell community on Discord:[/u]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/greenhell][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/c34541bf6da6b77647a98c63b8cea9f095198232.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Storage & Transportation Update is coming on August 28!
notes.content:
Hello Adventures,

You might have heard about our update plans through the Pre-Update Beta and now, after a few weeks of your meticulous testing and of our even more diligent improvement to the new features we are so happy to finally announce that the official release of the S[b]torage & Transportation Update to Green Hell will go live on August 28![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/3f64cfde527f5d6ba4d02c3fb9a138f8133fc70c.jpg[/img]

What can you expect from the new update?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png[/img]
See below for a list of all the new additions to come in the latest update:

[list]
[*] [b]Sled[/b] - A new addition for transporting heavy objects that won’t fit in your Backpack! Players can put two different types of Heavy Objects into one Sled for transport.
[*] [b]Elevator[/b] - A new, much easier way of transporting heavy resources to both your base's upper floors and Tree Houses.
[*] [b]Shelf[/b] - Introducing a new universal storage option where you can store and display most of the items from your Backpack excluding weapons and sticks.
[*] [b]Hanging Shelf[/b] - Now you can add more storage space with the first wall add-ons. Adding shelving onto walls will free up space for players elsewhere in their houses.
[*] [b]Small Storage Basket[/b] - An improved version of the Small Stone Stand, the Small Storage Basket can hold various types of objects: Stone, Obsidian Stone, Charcoal, Bone, Plank, etc.
[*] [b]Large Storage Basket[/b] - Similar to above, an improved version of the Big Stone Stand that can hold various types of heavy objects such as Big Stone, Green Coconut, Mud Brick, etc.
[*] [b]Significant changes in storage:[/b]
-  More universal Stands and Storage: One universal Leaf Stand can store both Banana and Palm Leaves. This also applies to the Log Stand, the Stick Stand, and the Long Stick Stand.
- New Bamboo versions of Stands: Every storage construction now has a bamboo version.
- Increased capacity of Stands: Some older Stands, such as the Rope Stand, now have extended capacity.
- Improved item storing & removing mechanic: Players can now place an item in storage with a single button push and take it out with another.
[*] [b]Removed animation delay for picking up items:[/b] Players no longer have to wait for an animation to complete to pick up another item. The faster one clicks, the faster one picks!
[/list]
In just less than two weeks you’ll be able to put all the improvements to the test. But until then... stay sane on the treetops!

Creepy Jar Team

notes.title: Pre-Update Beta Update!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

Thanks to your feedback, we've made some major changes in the quality of life features while using the new items from Storage & Transportation! Enjoy them now on the updated build of the Pre-Update Beta. 

[b][h3]PLEASE NOTE: [/h3]In order to enjoy the new PUB version please start your game on a new save and please reset your keybinds.[/b]
Using a Save Game from the previous version of the PUB will cause major technical issues which might make it difficult to enjoy the game and thus influence your feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/400b72c742444b8f2a3b7e1e06368a2c9bafa2e4.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Player can now sprint with the Sled at the cost of increased stamina depletion,
[*] Capacity of the Sled was adjusted according to the ammount of resources a Player can carry in their hands,
[*] Capacity of the Elevator was adjusted according to the ammount of resources a Player can carry in their hands,
[*] A Player can now ride the Elevator
[*] A Player can now send the Elevator to the floor of their choice,
[*] Inserting items into Storage now uses the same keybid as dropping items on the ground - Q. It can be changed in the Keybid Options. It has been changed on the controller as well,
[*] Player can now disable Fast Pickup (removed animation delay) in the Game Settings,
[*] Take max' feature is now added to all storage constructions
[*] Ghosts of storage constructions now display stored items, so they won't collide with other objects after being built
[/list]

If you haven't already checked our Pre-Beta Update, follow the instructions below:

[b]In order to take part in the Storage & Transportation Pre Update Beta (PUB), you'll need to:[/b]
- have Green Hell added to your Steam library - and downloaded as well,
- click the right mouse button on it, and choose “Properties”,
- in the popup choose option “Betas”, then enter beta access code: “LoveYourCapybara”, and select “GH_PUB” branch,
- now you can play the Storage & Transportation Update contents before their release - in the Pre Update Beta access!
- If you still can't see the GH_PUB branch after typing the code in, please restart the Steam client and try again. Please note that you won’t be able to move saves between your main game and PUB.

Since the PUB is still a work in progress, it is not impossible that you may experience crashes - this is when some specific commands will appear in the left-bottom part of the screen.
Whenever that happens - please save your progress and restart the game.

We’re still waiting for your feedback in comments, in the dedicated [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/815370/discussions/0/3803902423380211788/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]thread[/url], at support@creepyjar.com, and on #beta-tests on [url=https://discord.com/invite/greenhell]Green Hell Discord server[/url]!

Stay sane on the treetops,
Creepy Jar Team

notes.title: Pre Update Beta of the Storage & Transportation Update is live now!
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers,
A new update, Storage & Transportation is getting near to its Steam release (date yet to be revealed), and starting today, all of you can test its contents in the new Pre Update Beta! And there are great new features & enhancements to be tested:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/59842850d14bc66e6029ae4a49f04a50caf733be.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Sled - a new addition for transporting heavy objects which won’t fit in your Backpack. You can put two different types of Heavy Objects in one Sled,
[*] Elevator - a new, easier way of transporting heavy resources to both upper floors of your base and to Tree Houses,
[*] Shelf - a new type of universal storage, that you can unpack most of the items from your Backpack - excluding weapons and sticks,
[*] Hanging Shelf - now you can add more storage space with the first wall add-ons,
[*] Small Storage Basket - a new improved version of the Small Stone Stand. It can hold various types of objects: Stone, Obsidian Stone, Charcoal, Bone, Plank,
[*] Large Storage Basket - a new improved version of the Big Stone Stand. It can hold various types of heavy objects such as: Big Stone, Green Coconut, Mud Brick,
[/list]
Major changes in storage:
[list]
[*] More universal Stands and Storages: one universal Leaf Stand can store both Banana and Palm leaves. Also applies to the Log Stand, the Stick Stand and the Long Stick Stand,
[*] New Bamboo versions of Stands: every storage construction has now its bamboo version,
[*] Increased capacity of Stands: some older Stands, such as the Rope Stand, have now extended capacity,
[*] Improved item storing & removing mechanic: now you can place an item in storage with a single button, and take it out with another,
[*] Removed animation delay for picking up items: you no longer have to wait for animation to complete to pick another item. The faster you click, the faster you pick,
[*] Improved Blueprint Snapping System: you should be able to aim and snap your construction blueprints to already existing constructions more precisely.
[/list]
[b]To take part in the Storage & Transportation Pre Update Beta (PUB), you need to:[/b]
- have Green Hell added to your Steam library - and downloaded as well,
- click the right mouse button on it, and choose “Properties”,
- in the popup choose option “Betas”, then enter beta access code: “LoveYourCapybara”, and select “GH_PUB” branch,
- now you can play the Storage & Transportation Update contents before their release - in the Pre Update Beta access!
- If you still can't see the GH_PUB branch after checking the code in, please restart the Steam client and try again. [b]Please note that you won’t be able to move saves between your main game and PUB. [/b]

Since the PUB is still a work in progress, it is not impossible that you may experience crashes - this is when some specific commands will appear in the left-bottom part of the screen.
Whenever that happens - please save your progress and restart the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/a003a8c3d32c9f2df17afdc3c02dbe32dd7f3334.png[/img]

The whole point of beta tests is to get your honest feedback - what you love, and what not-so-much regarding the Storage & Transportation Update contents so far. We’ve added even more ways to receive your feedback than earlier:
- as you close the game on the testing branch, a Google Forms questionnaire will appear. There’s a set of questions dedicated to every new feature and improvement, and your answers will be helpful to determine whether are they easy to build, and use, simply, do they serve their purpose, 
#dev-chat with the current Project Lead of Green Hell, working in Creepy Jar for more than 6 years. From the very early stage of the development he was always at the front line, taking care of testing, design, and management. Currently leading a team that takes care of all new content added to Green Hell.[b] Jacek will be online for your questions on the 12th of July at 5 PM CEST / 4 PM BST / 8 AM Pacific for 60 minutes,[/b]
- beyond all of that, we’re waiting for your feedback in comments, in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/815370/discussions/0/3803902423380211788/]dedicated thread[/url], at support@creepyjar.com, and on #beta-tests on [url=https://discord.com/invite/greenhell]Green Hell Discord server[/url]!

Thanks to the survey results and your opinions gathered from the Discord channel and the Steam thread together, we’ll shape the final Storage & Transportation Update experience, which we plan to release in just a few weeks!

Stay sane on the treetops,
Creepy Jar Team

notes.title: New roadmap!
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers,

Thank you for your input in the Pre Update Beta, the [i]What should we add to Green Hell?[/i] questionnaire and the steady flow of suggestions on Steam forums, Discord, social media channels and emails! We also wanted to give a special shoutout to all the players who showed us their adventures in the jungle on streams, videos and screenshots. 

We’ve collected all your feedback together, confronted it with our plans for the further development of the game and poof! [b]We are very proud to reveal to you our plans for Green Hell![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/c2de8b80b0842e17ee303e1bf2e4a0d866aba0b3.png[/img]

[b]What's brewing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Storage & Transportation: because a bigger base needs a bigger amount of resources, and more storage places,
[*] Combat Update: because a bigger base leads to a bigger number of uninvited Tribe members.  Prepare for their visit, because they WILL be prepared for you.
[*] New Animals: the more the merrier!
[/list]
Stay sane while planning your road ahead in the jungle,
Creepy Jar Team

notes.title: Building Update is out now!
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

After four weeks of improving the Building Update according to the PUB feedback gathered from thousands of you, the wait is over - [b]the Building Update is officially live[/b]! 

[previewyoutube=zCmUrEJfJ_g;full][Trailer]
[/previewyoutube]
A huge thing about the Building Update is that there are new construction options to be built in entirely new places - on [b]treetops [/b]and [b]water[/b]. And you can finish your fortress with new versions of Walls and Platforms made from [b]Wood [/b]and [b]Bamboo[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/d8e5bb53ead0a437b26804cc5097d7ef6824b581.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Build your home in the trees[/b] - Utilizing a new Climbing Rope construction, players can head to the treetops to build their very own treehouse! Find the biggest tree around—covered with Indigo Blue Leptonia Mushrooms and Banisteropsis Vine—and assemble your two-story Wooden/Bamboo Tree House,
[*] [b]Footbridge[/b] - Make easy walking connections between your tree constructions as well as your water and land abodes,
[*] [b]Whatever floats your boat[/b] - The new Floating Frame & Triangular Floating Frame will allow players to build their abode up to 3 floors high right on the water,
[*] [b]3-sided fun[/b] - Use new Wooden/Bamboo Triangular Frames to create a more unique home than ever before,
[*] [b]STAY OUT![/b] - Keep out unwanted visitors with Wooden/Bamboo Doors,
[*] [b]More building material options[/b] - Bamboo and Wood everywhere! Build new versions of walls, roofs, and ceilings out of the material of your fancy,
[*] [b]Hit ‘em hard[/b] - No predator is safe when players wield the all-new Heavy Stone Axe, the first two-handed axe players can craft on their own,
[*] [b]Revamped notebook[/b] - The player notebook is slimmer and more organized than ever,
[*] [b]Clear your path[/b] - Cut down big palms, logs, stumps, and branches to clear your path all through the Amazon.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/bcc715f2a8c1a31ae6049075ae16c326edb64f07.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Big Stones no longer disappear when being carried on longer distances,
[*] Ropes on trees respawn more frequently,
[*] Players are now able to pick up heavy objects while diving,
[*] Tribesmen and animals can no longer walk through walls,
[*] Fixed translation errors in Turkish version,
[*] Ladders should no longer block the way when built near a doorway,
[*] Players can now properly see dirt on other players' bodies in co-op sessions,
[*] Placing frames on upper levels of custom buildings should be more convenient now,
[*] Fishermen’s water slot should no longer disappear after reloading,
[*] Players should be able to snap other constructions to Fires (Small Fire and Campfire),
[*] Removed an overscaled plant from Spirits of Amazonia 3 area,
[*] Arrow buttons for turning pages in the Notebook are no longer transparent,
[*] Pressing 'T' no longer brings out radio during renaming animals or plants in the Story Mode,
[*] HUD displayed during placing items into constructions should now be snapped to the center of the screen,
[*] Changed the position of 'Name' option in the expand menu,
[*] Ghost placing mode no longer turns off after placing a single ghost.
[/list]
We’re really happy with your engagement in the Pre Update Beta - 60% of players who participated declared that they’d spent at least 2 hours playing it! Thanks to information provided by you, we were able to improve resource balance for buildings and gather detailed information about what you’d like to see in next updates. And we’re keeping that as a food for thought in planning Green Hell's future. While speaking of the future, we’d like to make more beta tests of the upcoming updates, with an improved way of getting your feedback, so we really hope to see you there! 

Thank you so much for your support during this month of Pre Update Beta tests, and stay sane on the treetops!

Creepy Jar Team

notes.title: Building Update - full release coming on January 23rd!
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers,

After three weeks of intense work on your feedback to the Pre Update Beta, we’re ready to share the date of the final release of the [b]Building Update[/b]: it’s the [b]23rd of January[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Whole new mechanic of building constructions on trees - Wooden / Bamboo [b]Tree House Frame[/b], Wooden / Bamboo [b]Tree Platform Frame[/b], and a [b]Footbridge[/b] connecting the aforementioned. There is also a new [b]Climbing Rope[/b] construction which is necessary for reaching the treetops, 
[*] [b]Triangular Floating Frame[/b] will let you build your abode on water - up to 3 floors high!
[*] New weapon - [b]Heavy Stone Axe[/b], the first two handed axe that you can craft on your own,
[*] Introducing [b]Triangular Frame[/b] & [b]Triangular Floating Frame[/b], which will allow you to build new shapes on both ground and water,
[*] Wooden / Bamboo [b]Doors[/b] - now you can let everybody know if you're waiting for some jungle guests… Or not!
[*] New building material options - now you can build Bamboo or Wooden [b]Walls[/b] & [b]Platforms[/b],
[*] Improved mechanic of placing multiple ghost constructions - now you can place more than one at a time,
[*] [b]New Notebook arrangement[/b] - now the Notebook is slimmer and more concise - you don’t have to shuffle numerous pages to find the construction and the material you’d like to make it from,
[*] Some slight changes in names of constructions to make them more straightforward: Wall, Window Wall, Doorway Wall, Short Wall and Frame,
[*] New option of cutting down Big Palms, Logs, Stumps, Branches - now you’ll be able to clear your path in the Amazonia.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/4caae6ca1e5f9e4a21cac7edc3a360848ea3b852.png[/img]

There were thousands of answers to our questionnaire, tons of feedback delivered through Steam, email and every social media platform we’re on. Thank you so much for your participation and input - this means a lot to us. We’ll take it as a nod of approval for our work, and the gathered feedback will serve us as a compass for further development of Green Hell.

Stay sane on the treetops!
Creepy Jar Team

New weapon - [b]Heavy Stone Axe[/b], the first two handed axe that you can craft on your own,
Introducing [b]Triangular Frame[/b] & [b]Triangular Floating Frame[/b], which will allow you to build new shapes on both ground and water,
Wooden / Bamboo [b]Doors[/b] - now you can let everybody know if you're waiting for some jungle guests… Or not!
New building material options - now you can build Bamboo or Wooden [b]Walls[/b] & [b]Platforms[/b],
Improved mechanic of placing multiple ghost constructions - now you can place more than one at a time,
[b]New Notebook arrangement[/b] - now the Notebook is slimmer and more concise - you don’t have to shuffle numerous pages to find the construction and the material you’d like to make it from,
Some slight changes in names of constructions to make them more straightforward: Wall, Window Wall, Doorway Wall, Short Wall and Frame,
New option of cutting down Big Palms, Logs, Stumps, Branches - now you’ll be able to clear your path in the Amazonia.

notes.title: Pre Update Beta of the Building Update is live now!
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers,

If you remember our road map, we teased that the Building Update will have features like Tree Houses, Footbridge, Triangle Constructions and Doors - but we’ve decided to extend this list by a lot. And before we fully release it, we’d really like to know your opinion on its contents and balance - that is why we proudly announce the opening of the Pre Update Beta (PUB in short) where you can test the new work-in-progress update to your heart’s content! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Whole new mechanic of building on trees - Wooden / Bamboo Tree House, Wooden / Bamboo Tree Platform and a Footbridge connecting the aforementioned. There is also a new Climbing Place construction which is necessary for reaching the treetops. A Tree House can be built on the biggest tree you’ll see around - the one covered with Indigo Blue Leptonia Mushrooms and Banisteriopsis Vine. Tree Platforms can be placed on thinner trees, the ones that can’t be cut and are often covered with ivy. Bonus: you can build two floors in your Tree House!
[*] Floating Platform will let you build your abode on water - up to 3 floors high,  
[*] New axe - Heavy Stone Axe,
[*] Introducing Triangular Constructions with Wooden / Bamboo Triangular Frames,
[*] Wooden / Bamboo Doors - now you can let everybody know if you're waiting for uninvited jungle guests… Or not!
[*] New building material options - now you can build Bamboo or Wooden Walls & Roofs & Ceilings, 
[*] Improved mechanic of placing multiple ghost constructions - now you can place more than one at a time,
[*] New Notepad arrangement - now the Notebook is slimmer and more concise -  you don’t have to shuffle numerous pages to find  the construction and the material you’d like to make it from,
[*] New option of cutting down Big Palms, Logs, Stumps, Branches - now you’ll be able to clear your path in the Amazonia,
[/list]

[h3][b]To take part in the Building Update’s Pre Update Beta (PUB), you need to:[/b]
[/h3][list]
[*] have Green Hell added to your Steam library - and downloaded as well,
[*] click the right mouse button on it, and choose “Properties”,
[*] in the popup choose option “Beta”, then activate the code: LoveYourCapybara, and select “GH_PUB” branch,
[*] now you can play the Building Update contents before their release - in thePre Update Beta access!
[*] If after putting the code in you still can't see the GH_PUB branch, please restart Steam - and try again. You won’t be able to move saves between your main game and PUB. 
[/list]

Since the PUB is still a work in progress, it is not impossible that you may experience crashes - this is when some specific commands will appear in the right- bottom part of the screen.
Whenever that happens - please save your progress and restart the game.

Most crucial part of the beta tests is your  feedback. That’s why after you close the game, a short Google Forms questionnaire will appear - and we know, it’s a popup, but please don’t skip it!

Below the popup - here's a dedicated thread [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/815370/discussions/0/5551280551725724821/]here[/url]. We’re planning some AMA on our Discord, so make sure to join us there - everything will be posted in #announcements and #beta-tests channels! 

By getting the survey results and your opinions on both Discord and Steam together, we’ll shape the final Building Update experience, which we’re planning to release in no longer than a few weeks.

Stay sane on the treetops!

Creepy Jar Team

notes.title: No more Unknown flora - with the new Plant Naming Patch V2.3.6!
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers,

Three years ago we released Plant Cultivation Update, which allowed you to become a self-sufficient jungle farmer. And now, we’ve decided to improve the Plant Cultivation mechanic with a frequently requested feature: now [b]you can name all “Unknown” flora[/b] and its fruits in your Notebook! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/ae532452e39d72bf42926d5397eca41f47add7ed.png[/img]

From now on it will be easier to let the future Jake know what the past Jake has already discovered about a given specimen of the flora. And this will not only be visible in your Notebook, but in the whole jungle! If future Jake decides to extend the research and - due to new experiments - comes to different conclusions, you can easily rename a given plant to your liking. 

Along with this new feature, we’ve added few fixes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/bcc715f2a8c1a31ae6049075ae16c326edb64f07.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Items in racks no longer duplicate after destroying the rack in a co-op session
[*] Gathering of the Queen Bee trigger can now be rebound
[*] Torches are now more effective against big cats
[*] Fertilizer now affects fruits’ growth time
[*] Fixed issues with climbing the ladder in Spirits of Amazonia boat
[*] Plant Boxes no longer gather water under a roof
[*] Plants Tab in Notebook should now work properly
[*] Added proper drawing for Albahaca and Psychotria Flowers in the Plant Tab in Notebook
[/list]
Except for the Plant Naming Patch, we’re building something more for you, Adventurers. Stay tuned, we’ll update you pretty soon!

Creepy Jar Team

notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

We’ve just released the newest Hotfix v.2.3.2, mostly focused on improving the game balance after the Animal Husbandry Update, plus some small fixes. Thank you for all the feedback concerning animal droppings, feeding, and gaining animals’ trust (and Jake’s sanity as well), both in single player and multiplayer sessions. Like through our whole journey through the jungle, your feedback served as a compass on how Green Hell should work! See the full patch notes below:

[*] The weight of the Queen Bee item has been adjusted

[*] HP of animals no longer resets after a reload

[*] Changing weapons when holding a Kid no longer causes errors

[*] Cooldown of gaining Trust by petting an animal no longer resets after a reload

[*] Controller inputs no longer get blocked after skipping the Tutorial
[*] Animals no longer despawn from the Pen after a reload
[*] Guanabana fruit can now be fed to animals
[*] Tied Animals no longer duplicate after being killed in a multiplayer session
[*] Animal droppings found in the jungle now spawn properly
[*] Animals no longer randomly lose trust when walking in the Pen
[*] The Queen Bee item no longer disappears when dragged out of inventory
[*] The rate of Animal Droppings being spawned inside the Pen has been reduced
[*] Animal are now able to escape the Pen when the door is open
[*] It is no longer possible to endlessly increase Blowgun skill by shooting at a Honeycomb

We hope you’d be able to find some time to wander through the jungle with your improved and best jungle pet: the capybara!
