notes.title: Animal Husbandry update is out now!
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

Today we’ve changed the rules of Green Hell - at least, a bit. From now on, Jake Higgins can build an [b]animal pen[/b] and breed three animals: [b]capybara[/b], [b]tapir [/b]and [b]peccary[/b]!

[previewyoutube=VIsU5xABRHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

To capture those beautiful creatures a new weapon - [b]the Blowpipe[/b] - will come in handy. With the use of the blow darts imbued with the Poison Dart Frog venom you can put your catch to sleep, unharmed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/dbb2d03b75a803f7ada80386fa18d98c6b2da0dc.gif[/img]

And as you’ve probably guessed, in order to become friends with the captured animal  you’ll need to put some effort into it! As you put the animal into its pen and take care of it by feeding and cleaning the place, you’ll gain its trust. When your herd is happy, you can see it grow in numbers! Enjoy the company of both parents and their cute newborns. And the most important thing - the animals will respond to your whistle, and you’ll be able to [b]PET THE ANIMAL[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/92c3c845cf8dd4a62b79d49ff5d1f9a174da1f9a.gif[/img]

Animal Husbandry update also adds [b]a beekeeping mechanic[/b], so now, besides plants and meat, you’re able to harvest a premium snack of the Amazonian jungle: [b]honey[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/18f8ae29663b7efa43f458dc789158f1f888f674.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]An entirely new mechanic:[/b] Player now can tame capybara, peccary and tapir
[*] [b]A new weapon:[/b] The Blowpipe - to catch a capybara, a peccary or a tapir, you gotta shoot 'em with poison darts that will put it to sleep. Other animals and threats will also fall asleep (forever…)
[*] [b]Taking care of your animals:[/b] supply them with fresh food and water, tidy up their pen so they won’t get sick. And if they trust you, they’ll let you PET THEM
[*] [b]Breed animals:[/b] If you’ll lead female and male animal feel good in their pen, you can be suprised with a newborn
[*] [b]Beekeeping:[/b] complete your farm with beehive, then colonize it with the queen bee and enjoy one of the rarest snacks of the jungle - honey
[*] [b]New constructions:[/b] Animal Pen, Beehive, Feeding Trough, Water Trough, Frog Stretcher 
[/list]

Thank you so much for your support. We can’t wait to hear what’s your favourite feature from the [b]Animal Husbandry[/b] Expansion!

notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

The wait is finally over and we are proud to announce that you can explore the mysteries of Spirits of Amazonia 3 NOW!

[previewyoutube=uZt9Xv3RRyk;full][/previewyoutube]

In Part 1 of the Spirits of Amazonia expansion, you’ve stepped back into Jake’s shoes as he befriended an Amazonian tribe for the first time. Part 2 continued the journey, introducing a new hunting tribe, new animals, and new weapons while propelling you even deeper into the epic Amazonian mystery. Looking ahead to part 3, Jake’s adventure comes to its thrilling conclusion. See below for more details:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/0a00d5b877867c71eac1fe72b8383937e1f11fe8.jpg[/img]

[*] 4 new legends
[*] A brand new AI, the centipede
[*] 2 new activities, 2 new weapons, a new pottery mechanic, and more

notes.title: 2022 Road Map!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

The year is almost over and we are excited to give you a sneak peek into what's coming for Green Hell in 2022!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/91346c390062432ea184805c542d1006ae655100.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Spirits of Amazonia Part 3[/b]: The third and final act of the thrilling Spirits of Amazonia story comes to a conclusion and will be free for all owners of Green Hell.
[*] [b]Building Update[/b]: The existing building system receives a hefty update that will be less restrictive than the current system. The ability to cut through thicker trees—removing obstacles such as stumps and logs—allows players maximum flexibility when placing their buildings. New items such as doors, bridges, treehouses, and more will be added.
[*] [b]Animal Husbandry[/b]: Become the master of your domain and farm animals for many of your needs. Players will be able to catch, breed, and feed some of the rainforest’s creatures; keep them in custom pens, and—when the time comes—harvest them for the resources needed most. 
[/list]

More specific time frames for the arrival of updates will come at a later date, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Hotfix v2.1.4(Release Candidate) available on public_test branch!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

We have prepared a special build with many fixes and HUD scaling for you to check out!

Where to find it? On our [b]PUBLIC TEST BRANCH!
[/b]
How to change the branch on steam?
- Go to your library
- Right-click Green Hell and choose properties
- Go to the last Tab ‘Betas’
- Now from the expand menu choose branch 'public_test'

All the issues should be written in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/815370/discussions/2/] this part of the forum [/url]

This is a developer’s build, there are no debugs BUT! there is a debug console!(left bottom corner) If you have anything pop up choose ‘OPEN LOG’, save the text file and send it over to support@creepyjar.com with the save file you were playing on and with an info what were you doing when it happened.

Did it appear for host? Client? were you far/close from each other?

[b]IF THE ASSERT OR CRASH APPEAR DO NOT CONTINUE AND DO NOT SAVE!![/b] Just quit without saving, both Host and Clients! Restart the game fully, load the last save you had.

[u]
Your saves will not be present by default on this branch! If you want to play on your save go to:
C: / Program Files (x86) / Steam / userdata[unique Steam ID] / 815370 / remote.[/u]

There you will find your saves ex. MPSlot1.sav. To use it on Public Test branch, copy the file and paste it in the same folder adding 'PTR' between 'Slot' and number. Ex. MPSlot1.sav - MPSlotPTR1.sav


[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Converting back - from PTR to non-PTR save will most likely corrupt it! So the conversion works only one way!
We won't be able to help you if you convert it the other way around!

notes.title: Spirits of Amazonia - Part 2 on Public Test Branch!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

Now you have a chance to try out the second part of Spirits of Amazonia!

Where to find it? On our [u]PUBLIC TEST BRANCH![/u]

How to change the branch on steam?
- Go to your library
- Right-click Green Hell and choose properties
- Go to the last Tab ‘Betas’
- Now from the expand menu choose branch '[b]public_test[/b]'

All the issues should be written [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/815370/discussions/2/]in this part of the forum[/url]

This is a developer’s build, there are no debugs BUT! there is a debug console!(left bottom corner) If you have anything pop up choose ‘[b]OPEN LOG[/b]’, [u]save the text file and send it over[/u] to [b]support@creepyjar.com [/b][u]with the save file you were playing on[/u] and with an info what were you doing when it happened. 

Did it appear for host? Client? were you far/close from each other? 

[u]IF THE ASSERT OR CRASH APPEAR DO NOT CONTINUE AND DO NOT SAVE!![/u] Just quit without saving, both Host and Clients! Restart the game fully, load the last save you had.


[b]Your saves will not be present by default on this branch! If you want to play on your save go to:[/b]
[u]C: / Program Files (x86) / Steam / userdata[unique Steam ID] / 815370 / remote.[/u]

There you will find your saves ex. MPSlot1.sav. To use it on Public Test branch, copy the file and paste it in the same folder adding 'PTR' between 'Slot' and number. Ex. MPSlot1.sav - MPSlotPTR1.sav


[b][u]IMPORTANT:[/u][/b] Converting back - from PTR to non-PTR save will most likely corrupt it! So the conversion works only one way!
We won't be able to help you if you convert it the other way around!

notes.title: Road Map
notes.content:
[h1]The spirits on the road ahead![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/e2163ee0414e884d7595639ef73cf5a982e806a7.jpg[/img]

Today we're revealing our new roadmap for the upcoming months. Be sure to check out what's in store for Green Hell next. And yes, you're seeing correctly.[b] The Spirits of Amazonia[/b] will be a really large and FREE expansion. At the moment we're planning a[u] three parter[/u], but it initially didn't even have parts, so who knows?


You're probably wondering what to expect from such a large expansion? We can't spoil the surprise yet, but believe us - there's a lot to look forward to. Vastly expanded map? Sure. Co-operation with tribes, that you've asked us to add for a very long time? Of course we're listening! Trees regrowing? #Teamtrees!


But... let's stop here for now, so we don't run out of things to announce in the nearest future!
See you in the jungle!

notes.title: Asus Aura Sync Update - Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone.

Asus Aura Sync Update is live! We would like to thank you all for your support, bug reports and feedback. See you in Green Hell!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/e892ebffc3a5c1384ac56da5d6422a48ef344f30.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png[/img]
[list]

[*] [b]Added support for special lighting effects for Asus hardware supported by Aura Sync technology[/b]

[*] Added a [b]Troubleshooting menu [/b]into [b]Main[/b] and [b]Pause[/b] menus 

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/bcc715f2a8c1a31ae6049075ae16c326edb64f07.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Fixed - Items picked up from environment could duplicate in another Player’s inventory
[*]Fixed - Brews giving food poisoning only caused vomit without giving status effect
[*]Fixed - Achievement for completing tutorial unlocked after cutscene(some Players still have issues with movies crashing their game, that’s why we changed that so they can unlock the achievement)
[*]Fixed - There was a typo in Language select for 'Portugês' instead of 'Português' in Brasil Portuguese
[*]Fixed - Steam popup for Gardener achievement showed up at 7 instead of 6/12 plants

[/list]

More fixes coming soon... Stay tuned!

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]

EDIT: 
We've noticed that some of you found a workaround for the crash occuring after recent Green Hell update by deleting the AuraLayerManager.dll file.
Even if you delete AuraLayerManager.dll file, it will be downloaded again every time game is updated.
We've contacted Asus regarding this issue and we've been informed that such error may occur when using an outdated version of Asus Aura software.
Installing newest Asus Aura firmware should solve the problem:
Update Aura to the latest version (1.07.79_V2.1). Update can be found [url=https://www.asus.com/campaign/aura/global/download.php]here[/url]
Upgrade to the new platform Armoury Crate. Upgrade can be found [url=https://rog.asus.com/us/innovation/armoury_crate/]here[/url]
If neither of these methods worked for you please let us know by reporting it to support@creepyjar.com.
We have to make sure that this issue is contained only to Players that use Asus Aura so we kindly ask you to provide information on wether you use any Aura Sync software or not when reporting this issue to us.

notes.title: Dev Notes
notes.content:
Adventurers!

Two weeks passed since the last Dev Notes!

We are working hard to polish the mechanics within our Coop work. The current issue involves spawn rates of items for all players in a session.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/011f057670a9c2b150be4a809eb4c4932fc19f3b.jpg[/img]

Keep those bug reports coming! 

[b]Reminder for those reporting bugs: [/b]
[b]Before[/b] you write a new thread/Discord post, please check if there wasn’t something similar posted recently! Keeping the same issues or similar issues in the same thread will help us establish the severity/scope of the issue. 

When new issues appear out of the blue, remember to[b] verify steam files[/b] and[b] reload the game[/b] to ensure it isn't a temporary glitch. If the issue persists report it in already existing or new thread in bug reports on [b]Steam, Bug Channel on Discord. [/b]
[b]
[u]How to write a bug report:[/u][/b]
- write how to reproduce the issue
- include as much relevant information as possible: Is it survival or story mode? Which difficulty? How old is the save? Add screenshots!

If the issue occurs only on one of your saves and no one had the same problem, send us an email with your saved game.

[b] Here are instructions:[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/815370/discussions/1/1776010325116391886/

[u]What issues we are aware of:[/u]
-Bamboo Bridge is already built on some saves
-Rain inside shelters (only visual issue)
-Mud mixer resets after walking away
-Issue adding items to Stack over Stack limit, creating secondary issue in Storage.
-When Player places a ghost on top of a Mud Roof it gets properly cut off under it.
-Once Player inserts items into the ghost those parts of the ghost are visible and have collision.
-Coal stays in the air after destroying the Frame under the Mud Charcoal Furnace.
-Player cannot shoot through Stands, Smokers, Racks and Walls.
-Sometimes Sanity tribesmen are spawned in T pose.
-Weird camera position return after vomiting.
-Camera looks up when Player goes to sleep.
-No Fever or Poison reduction info in the Info Log and Effects of Consumption.
-Cannot sort Storage Box.
-Maggots become huge when their decay timer runs out.
-Igniting a torch with low stamina ignites it after stamina regenerates.

notes.title: Dev Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Adventurers![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/7ec896a22f3ac675b8f3f444e3727b4eca001476.jpg[/img]

The past few weeks we were busy working on the[b] Plant Cultivation Update[/b]- which went live [b]yesterday![/b] Testing new mechanics took us some time- brainstorming ideas (we weren't sure if we should add droppings as fertilizer or not) and sorting through suggestions. We hope you will have fun and enjoy it. :)

We do know that the update possibly changed few settings (key bindings) and we are looking into that today.

Our animators are sorting through a ton of new motion-capture data that they are integrating into their work for coop. Please continue to send your suggestions to our Discord bot Jungle Jeeves if you are in Discord, or post them to Steam- we are adding suggestions to an internal list for talking over.

[h1][b]Some other quick updates:[/b][/h1]
- The team is holding meetings on our work plan for Expanded Shelters

- We have gathered your Ideas for Steam Achievements from Steam Thread and Discord 
Channel and our Designer Michał has chosen some of them. (Discord members, the "Steam Achievement" channel will be retired shortly!)

- We are working on a Turkish translation for the game

notes.title: Green Hell Launches into 1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/82743b2db6a63bd31e9c7577ac1c6f3d74725e08.jpg[/img]

[h1]We are excited to announce that Green Hell leaves Early Access and launches into 1.0. ![/h1]

[u]Watch the Green Hell 1.0 Lauch Trailer:[/u]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EOCzDVTsfug

Green Hell saw huge improvements and regular updates during the Early Access phase and now sees a ton of new features accompany this momentous launch. 
From an entirely new map area to new animals and custom difficulty settings, the 1.0 update is Green Hell’s largest yet. Story Mode, one of the most anticipated features of all, will see players test more than just their survival skills as they embark on a desperate mission to navigate the deadly Amazon rainforest and rescue their lost love, Mia.

In the year since Green Hell launched into Early Access, we have worked continuously on improving the game alongside incorporating feedback from our dedicated
community. See the list of additions and changes below:

[h1]Story Mode and 1.0 Update Additions[/h1]
● Story Mode! — How did you end up in the Amazon? What happened to your love, Mia?
How can you escape? How can you survive? Seeking answers to these questions will
take you to the brink of sanity as you rediscover well-known areas and discover new
areas for the first time.
● New Map Areas — The lush rainforest of Green Hell gets even bigger with new
Wetlands to explore. Also included, is an all-new in-game map!
● Perma-Death Difficulty — Gear up for the most ruthless challenge yet. There’s no
coming back from death.
● New Graphics Options — Optimize your experience with new FOV, Vsync, antialiasing,
texture quality, and shadow distance options.
● New Plants and Animals — Introducing the psychosis-inducing Psychotria Viridis, the
Banisterposis Caapi, and the lethally poisonous Dart Frog.
● Decay Timer— Many items in the game will now start to wither and decay. Players will
have to be vigilant learning to use their items before they expire.
● New Difficulty Levels (Tourist, King of the Jungle, Custom) — Have a problem with
snakes? Maybe spiders? Introducing new difficulty options to turn tribes, predators,
spiders, snakes, and the sanity meter on or off! Hate managing macroelements? Green
Hell is also adding a depletion speed slider to adjust how quickly you need to replenish
yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/59842850d14bc66e6029ae4a49f04a50caf733be.png[/img]

notes.title: Green Hell Early Access Date Announcement
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that their first-person, psychological survival simulator, Green Hell will be hitting Steam Early Access on August 29th, 2018! Set in the uncharted depths of the sweltering Amazon rainforest players will be challenged at every turn in a desperate quest for survival. From the harsh rainforest environment to its wild inhabitants, the player may never know friend from foe until it’s too late. Check out the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6T_V4RhejHo]all new Green Hell Early Access trailer![/url]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6T_V4RhejHo

Upon the Early Access release, players will be able to dive into a full one half of the final map, encounter five dangerous and hostile creatures, and learn how to inspect their bodies for all kinds of wounds, infections, and parasitic nasties. Not only that, they can get a sneak peek into the Story Mode with a fully voiced over tutorial introduction.

Beginning its journey with a huge amount of content, Green Hell players can also look forward to updates containing new tribal enemies, cool new death animations, a water update introducing diving and fishing, and even more languages beyond the initial offerings of English, French, Italian, German and Spanish. Stay tuned for more updates on Green Hell’s development roadmap!


[h1]﻿Key Features[/h1]

[b]Realistic Survival Simulator[/b] - Green Hell puts great focus on realism in both its world building and gameplay. Everything that is crafted or built is necessary for survival, and was consulted on with experts. The Amazon is not a typical forest; threats are literally crawling under your skin.

[b]Psychological Thriller[/b]  - Waking up in the middle of the Amazon with no recollection of how you got there or how you’ll get out, the hardest battle you’ll face is the fight against yourself and your weaknesses and fears.

[b]Fully Alive Amazon Rainforest[/b] - Every effort has gone into recreating the lush world of the Amazon in painstaking detail. An exotic and dangerous place, this jungle is filled with many hazards beyond predators including toxic plants, illnesses and infections, all waiting to bring the player to their demise.

[b]Body Inspection[/b] - Dangers lurk around every bend but they also live under your very skin. Paramount to your survival is checking your body for parasites, infections, and wounds. Take care or suffer the consequences.

---

[i]A big thank you to everyone who has shown their excitement for the game, we look forward to providing you with more updates leading up to the early access launch![/i]

notes.title: Green Hell - Language availability
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We here at Creepy Jar truly appreciate everyone’s interest in the game from all around the world.
With such a varied audience, we would like to address the topic of languages in which Green Hell will be released.

[h1]At Early Access Launch the following languages will be available:[/h1]
English (Audio & Subtitles)
French (Subtitles)
Italian (Subtitles)
German (Subtitles)
Spanish (Subtitles)

[h1]These languages will be available for the full launch:[/h1]
Czech (Subtitles)
Dutch (Subtitles)
Finnish (Subtitles)
Japanese (Subtitles)
Korean (Subtitles)
Norwegian (Subtitles)
Polish (Subtitles)
Portuguese (Subtitles)
Portuguese-Brazil (Subtitles)
Russian (Subtitles)
Simplified Chinese (Subtitles)
Swedish (Subtitles)
Traditional Chinese (Subtitles)
Turkish (Subtitles)

We can’t provide any exact dates yet, but some of these languages may even be added in the first few weeks of Early Access! 

Some of you may notice that even our native language of Polish won't be available for the Early Access launch day. As part of our dedication to releasing a game that we’re proud of and that you will enjoy, we need to take the time to ensure that we won't release an unpolished and buggy version of the game. We hope you’ll stay along for the ride and want to thank each and every one of you for your support thus far.

[b]Creepy Jar Dev Team[/b]
